title: Smart speaker
prompt: a smart speaker on a shelf: say the wake word, ask a question that travels to a server and back, play music, and press the mute button; see-through shows the microphone ring, chip, Wi-Fi radio, speaker cone and light ring
blurb: A smart speaker hears its wake word on its own chip, sends your question as Wi-Fi packets through the router to a server, and plays the answer back through its tweeter and down-firing woofer, while the mute button cuts power to the microphones.
